details:
Full disclosure I don't know what the current automated systems looks like or if something like this is already implemented, but this needs to be addressed in some capacity. 

Currently avatar assets are seemingly completely unmoderated allowing for textures, models and other features that break TOS to be uploaded en mass by anyone on public avatars. This also extends to stickers and emojis which I can't count the amount of straight up TOS breaking ones I've seen.

I propose developing an automated moderation system that unpacks avatars & worlds and screens textures, model data and other features when they get uploaded and checks it against known assets and data that are in violation of TOS. This system can either tag the asset or block the upload entirely and can also retroactively scan avatars/worlds on the platform. Many TOS violating avatars and worlds use the exact same models or textures, this could be a very effective way of getting a lot of malicious or inappropriate avatars off the platform.

Obviously this won't be a perfect system and will likely have false positives but it would cut down on the workload of the trust and safety team a lot and keep the platform safer for everyone. A system like this is very do able to create and deploy and can keep improving exponentially over time. 

I understand AI moderation and AI in general is controversial but moderation is one of the most taxing and thankless jobs in existence that could benefit greatly from human in the loop automation. I'm hopeful the VRChat team can take this issue more seriously as it's been going unchecked for years and has been ruining the game's reputation and worst of all creating a very unsafe environment for kids/teens which makes up a large percentage of VRChat's demographic.

Benefits

- Will help greatly reduce the number of TOS violating avatars stopping them from being seen in game.

- Greatly improved user safety especially for users under 18 who will have a much lower likelihood of getting exposed to inappropriate content if it's being proactively moderated with automated checks and a Trust and Safety team with more time and resources to take on bigger issues.

- Discourage would be offenders from uploading inappropriate and TOS violating content making the problem easier for the Trust and Safety team to deal with.

- Improve the difficult job of moderation for the entire Trust and Safety team.

- Improve VRChat's overall reputation.
title: Automated moderation for avatar & world texture and model data
